correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md and arXiv:1708.02482 H-description, write N=n+1, mu=3^N/N, W=sum normal coefficients, Q=sum squares and P=Q-W²/N; intrinsic distance is (mu W-kappa)/sqrt(P). Singleton has kappa=3, P=n/N and distance (3^N-3N)/sqrt(Nn). For t>=2, H=sqrt(NP/n)<=sqrt(Q)<=W-t+sqrt(t), hence W-H>=t-sqrt(t). Compare kappa<3^(t+1)/2+1 with mu>=3^(t+1)/(t+1); t>=6 wins strictly, other cases reduce to five (N,t) rational inequalities. Independent exact rational reconstruction for n=2..12 checks strict separation and minima 45,1191/2,1683/2,53901/5,118818 at (3,2),(4,2),(4,3),(5,4),(6,5). The symbolic growth inequality, not finite sampling, covers all n>=2. Singleton halfspaces xi>=3 and sum xi=3^N give global radius upper bound and force equality center uniform, proving uniqueness.
